The issuer exhibits solid profitability and operating cash generation with an EBIT of $158M (EBIT margin ~21.8%) and net income of $64M, but carries a high leverage profile reflected in a Total Liabilities to Total Assets ratio of approximately 76% and a weak liquidity position with a current ratio of 0.72x. These credit metrics, alongside a moderate capital base (Shareholders' Equity of $829M), are consistent with an investment-grade profile at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
